result.summary: The prescribed implementation fails a mandatory acceptance check; reconcile the spec before dispatch.

findings.title: Remove the forbidden token from the required E2 replacement
findings.body: E2 explicitly inserts `AUTH-BLOCKED` into a comment, while AC-1 prohibits every occurrence and V-3 requires zero grep matches. Applying all six prescribed edits in memory reproduces the failure. Because the implementation must follow these literal blocks and may only change the spec's status, an implementer cannot satisfy both requirements.
findings.recommendation: Reword E2's comment to omit `AUTH-BLOCKED`, then verify V-3 against the source produced by all six prescribed edits.

next_steps: Reconcile E2 with AC-1 and V-3 before implementation.
